title.en: Motor Power 37 kW is the Electric LOW Pressure 40 Concrete Pump cell under “Cavitation”
title.zh: 「电机功率 37 kW」是「气蚀」下面的电动低压40型混凝土泵格子

description.en: Electric LOW Pressure 40 Concrete Pump at /products/electric-low-pressure-40-concrete-pump. Motor Power 37 kW Hopper Capacity 0.3 m³
description.zh: 电动低压40型混凝土泵见 /products/electric-low-pressure-40-concrete-pump。电机功率 37 kW料斗容积 0.3 m³

h1.en: Keep Electric LOW Pressure 40 Concrete Pump under “Application Ratio” without new ratings
h1.zh: 在「应用比」下保留电动低压40型混凝土泵，不另写额定值

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for Electric LOW Pressure 40 Concrete Pump. The row to open is /products/electric-low-pressure-40-concrete-pump. Motor Power 37 kW. Hopper Capacity 0.3 m³. Outlet Pressure 20 MPa. Main Unit Weight 1200 kg. Output Capacity 12–15 m³/h. Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki 112. The printed power cell is 37 kW. The printed output cell is 12–15 m³/h. Dimensions (L×W×H) 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm. The published cells are: Model Electric Low Pressure 40. Copy only the printed cells: Model Electric Low Pressure 40. Put /products/electric-low-pressure-40-concrete-pump in the subject. The printed distance row or rows: Fine Stone Pumping (H / V) 80 m / 240 m. For transport, copy Dimensions (L×W×H) is 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm and Main Unit Weight is 1200 kg. Output Capacity is 12–15 m³/h OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/electric-low-pressure-40-concrete-pump. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists the Electric Low Pressure 40 Concrete Pump at /products/electric-low-pressure-40-concrete-pump. The section title “Cavitation” comes from the source page and does not add a rating. No price is printed on the product page.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是电动低压40型混凝土泵的数字。要打开的行是 /products/electric-low-pressure-40-concrete-pump。电机功率 37 kW.料斗容积 0.3 m³.已印动力是 37 kW。整机重量 1200 kg。最大出口压力 20 MPa.液压泵 Kawasaki 112.理论输送量 12–15 m³/h.已印输送量是 12–15 m³/h。外形尺寸 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm.已印距离行：细石输送（水平/垂直） 80 m / 240 m。只抄已印格子：型号 Electric Low Pressure 40.已公布的格子是：型号 Electric Low Pressure 40.运输请抄外形尺寸是 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm，整机重量是 1200 kg。主题里写上 /products/electric-low-pressure-40-concrete-pump。河北品锦机械在邢台把电动低压40型混凝土泵列在 /products/electric-low-pressure-40-concrete-pump。理论输送量是 12–15 m³/h OEM 或改动从已列型号 /products/electric-low-pressure-40-concrete-pump 开始。节标题「气蚀」来自来源页，不另加额定值。产品页没有印价格。

The printed output cell is 12–15 m³/h. Copy only the printed cells: Model Electric Low Pressure 40. For transport, copy Dimensions (L×W×H) is 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm and Main Unit Weight is 1200 kg.
body.zh: 本节标题是「应用比」。电动低压40型混凝土泵下面这些格子仍是印出来的。料斗容积 0.3 m³.理论输送量 12–15 m³/h.已印输送量是 12–15 m³/h。只抄已印格子：型号 Electric Low Pressure 40.运输请抄外形尺寸是 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm，整机重量是 1200 kg。

body.en: Under “Multi Stage Control Valves”, Electric LOW Pressure 40 Concrete Pump contributes only the printed cells in this part. Outlet Pressure 20 MPa. Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki 112. Dimensions (L×W×H) 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm. Put /products/electric-low-pressure-40-concrete-pump in the subject. Output Capacity is 12–15 m³/h OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/electric-low-pressure-40-concrete-pump. The photograph is an image from the source page https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/control-valves-cavitation-d_490.html.
body.zh: 在「多级调节阀」下，电动低压40型混凝土泵这一节只放已印出的格子。最大出口压力 20 MPa.液压泵 Kawasaki 112.外形尺寸 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm.已公布的格子是：型号 Electric Low Pressure 40.理论输送量是 12–15 m³/h OEM 或改动从已列型号 /products/electric-low-pressure-40-concrete-pump 开始。配图来自来源页 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/control-valves-cavitation-d_490.html。

question.zh: 「气蚀」会替换「电机功率 37 kW」吗？

answer.en: No. Motor Power 37 kW remains the printed wording for Electric LOW Pressure 40 Concrete Pump.
answer.zh: 不会。电机功率 37 kW仍是电动低压40型混凝土泵已印的说法。

question.en: Where does Hopper Capacity 0.3 m³ belong on the Electric LOW Pressure 40 Concrete Pump row?
question.zh: 电动低压40型混凝土泵这一行里，「料斗容积 0.3 m³」放在哪里？

answer.en: It belongs on /products/electric-low-pressure-40-concrete-pump, beside the other printed cells, not under a guessed heading.
answer.zh: 它属于 /products/electric-low-pressure-40-concrete-pump，和其他已印格子在一起，不放到猜出来的标题下面。

question.en: What does “Application Ratio” add to Electric LOW Pressure 40 Concrete Pump?
question.zh: 「应用比」给电动低压40型混凝土泵增加了什么？

answer.en: It is only the section title taken from https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/control-valves-cavitation-d_490.html. It does not add a performance figure.
answer.zh: 它只是取自 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/control-valves-cavitation-d_490.html 的节标题，不增加性能数字。

question.en: Is a list price printed beside Motor Power 37 kW?
question.zh: 「电机功率 37 kW」旁边印了标价吗？
